title: Project Clothing
description: An eshop for a clothing store, featuring a product catalog,category browsing,dynamic data,filter system,login/register and administrative control panel

pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/index.png: Home page using HTML, CSS, PHP layout, JavaScript interactions, and image-based hero sections for the clothing collections.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/categories.png: Category page using PHP and MySQL data to show product groups with a styled HTML/CSS layout.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/catfilters.png: Filtered category view using JavaScript controls with PHP/MySQL product data and CSS cards.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/product-cardigan: Product detail page showing image thumbnails, size selection, cart totals, and order controls powered by PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and CSS.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/product-bag-cart: Bag product detail page with a product gallery, cart containing multiple items, quantity and subtotal data, and checkout controls.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/contact.png: Contact page using an HTML form, CSS styling, and PHP-ready structure for sending customer messages.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/contactstore.png: Store contact section using structured HTML, CSS layout, and store information blocks.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/dashboard.png: Admin dashboard using PHP and MySQL to manage store data with tables and dashboard actions.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/orders-dashboard: Orders dashboard using PHP and MySQL to display order IDs, users, totals, statuses, timestamps, and administrative actions.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/dashfilter.png: Dashboard filtering page using PHP/MySQL queries with form controls for finding products faster.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/edit-product.png: Product edit page using PHP forms, MySQL records, and admin controls for updating product details.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/latest.png: Latest products page using dynamic product data, PHP rendering, and responsive CSS product cards.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/login.png: Login page using an HTML form, CSS styling, and PHP authentication flow.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/news.png: News page using PHP-rendered content blocks and CSS cards for store updates.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/profile.png: Profile page using PHP session data, MySQL user records, and account management layout.
pictureDescriptions.assets/project-clothing/about.png: About page using HTML/CSS content sections to present the clothing store brand.

title: Hairsupplies Eshop
description: A complete hair-care product site with category browsing, dynamic product views, dashboard CRUD, and a refreshed asset library.

pictureDescriptions.assets/hairsupplies/index.png: Home page using HTML, CSS, PHP layout, JavaScript interactions, and product-focused salon supply sections.
pictureDescriptions.assets/hairsupplies/catalog.png: Catalog page using PHP and MySQL data to display product categories with reusable CSS cards.
pictureDescriptions.assets/hairsupplies/subcat.png: Subcategory page using dynamic PHP/MySQL filtering to show a focused product group.
pictureDescriptions.assets/hairsupplies/product.png: Product details page using PHP, MySQL product records, and styled product information sections.
pictureDescriptions.assets/hairsupplies/about.png: About page using HTML/CSS sections to describe the salon supplies store and its purpose.
pictureDescriptions.assets/hairsupplies/join.png: Join page using an HTML form, CSS styling, and PHP-ready user registration structure.
pictureDescriptions.assets/hairsupplies/news.png: News page using PHP-rendered updates and CSS blocks for store announcements.

title: Movie Library
description: A React movie library app for browsing a saved collection, adding new movies, selecting multiple genres, searching, sorting, rating, marking favorites, tracking watched status, editing entries inline, and saving the collection with local storage.

pictureDescriptions.assets/movie-library/movies.png: Main Movie Library dashboard showing collection stats, search, sorting controls, clear action, and movie cards.
pictureDescriptions.assets/movie-library/filters.png: Sorting dropdown with options for favorites, alphabetical order, watched status, and release date order.
pictureDescriptions.assets/movie-library/moviesdisplay.png: Movie card grid showing titles, multiple genre badges, release dates, ratings, favorites, watched toggles, and detail/edit actions.
pictureDescriptions.assets/movie-library/info.png: Expanded movie details view with actor list and description displayed below the main card controls.
pictureDescriptions.assets/movie-library/edit.png: Inline edit mode for updating movie title, release date, actors, description, director, and selected genres.
pictureDescriptions.assets/movie-library/add.png: Sidebar add-movie form with title, multi-select genre checkboxes, director, actors, description, and release date fields.

pictureDescriptions.assets/library/catalog.png: Catalog page using PHP and MySQL data to list books with category-style browsing.
pictureDescriptions.assets/library/book.png: Book detail page using PHP/MySQL records to show individual book information.
pictureDescriptions.assets/library/about.png: About page using HTML/CSS content sections to explain the library project.
pictureDescriptions.assets/library/slider.png: Slider section using JavaScript behavior with HTML/CSS presentation for featured library content.
